purpose.statement: For an independent evidence reviewer, present the minimum admitted derivation set sufficient to inspect the two orthogonal AG6 findings and the two explicit non-derivable bridges, while retaining all other admitted derivations and without promoting standing or authority.

selection_ruleset.eligibility_rule: A candidate view is eligible for purpose AG7-P001 iff its included_derivation_ids contain every mandatory_derivation_id. Eligibility does not alter the standing of the candidate or any underlying derivation.
selection_ruleset.selection_rule: Among eligible candidates, select the candidate with the smallest presentation_element_count. If tied, select the lexicographically smallest view_id. This is a purpose-bound presentation rule, not an evidentiary ranking.
selection_ruleset.retention_rule: Every candidate remains retained and addressable after selection. Non-selection does not imply rejection, invalidity, supersession, or evidentiary inferiority.
selection_ruleset.mutation_rule: Selection may add a selection relation only. It may not modify AG6 derivation objects or candidate definitions.
selection_ruleset.promotion_rule: Selection and presentation prominence do not change edge result classes, derivation standing, authority standing, or action authorization.

candidate_views.description: Purpose-bounded representation of identity/representation, resolution/standing, graph non-rewrite, non-derivable continuity and supersession, and no standing strengthening.
Focused representation of repeated missingness, supplemental-surface addition, and non-derivable continuity/supersession bridges.
